title: Urutonde rwo kwisuzuma – Kaboni n'ibinyabutabire bya kaboni
subject: Kemi
intro: Uru rutonde rukurikiza intambwe z'ingenzi z'igitabo cyo kwiga. Shyira akamenyetso ku byo wumva ufitiye icyizere, intambwe ku yindi. Ibyo mu gice cya Kwimbika ni iby'ushaka kujya kure kurushaho.

sections.title: 1. Shimi organike n'atomi ya kaboni (M1)
items: Nzi icyo shimi organike ari cyo n'impamvu yitwa shimi y'ibinyabutabire bya kaboni.
Nzi ko atomi ya kaboni ishobora gukora amasano ane.
Nzi amasano nitrogène (3), oksijeni (2) na hidrogene (1) bifite.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu kaboni ishobora gukora ibintu byinshi bitandukanye.

sections.title: 2. Kaboni itavanze mu miterere itandukanye (M2)
items: Nshobora kuvuga amazina y'imiterere itandukanye ya kaboni itavanze.
Nshobora gusobanura impamvu diyama ikomeye naho garafite yoroshye, nshingiye ku buryo atomi za kaboni zifatanye.
Nzi icyo kaboni ikora ikoreshwa n'impamvu ikora neza (ubuso bunini).

sections.title: 3. Alikane – urutonde rwa metani rwuzuye (M3)
items: Nzi icyo hidrokaboni ari cyo.
Nshobora kuvuga alikane umunani za mbere zikurikiranye.
Ndumva uburyo bwo kwita amazina bufite gahunda: "izina rya mbere" (umubare wa kaboni) + "izina rya nyuma" (-ane/-ene/-ine/-ile).

sections.title: 4. Alikeni na alikine – hidrokaboni zitujuje (M4)
items: Nzi itandukaniro riri hagati ya hidrokaboni zuzuye n'izitujuje.
Nzi imiterere y'isano ya etene na etine.
Nzi icyo etene ikoreshwa (pulasitiki ya polietene) n'icyo etine/asetileni ikoreshwa (gusudira).

sections.title: 5. Alikoli (M5)
items: Nzi icyo itsinda rya OH ari cyo kandi ko rigira ikintu alikoli.
Nshobora kwandika formule ya molekile n'imiterere y'isano ya metanoli (CH3OH) na etanoli (C2H5OH).
Nzi impamvu metanoli ari mbi kuyinywa.

sections.title: 6. Alikoli z'amatsinda menshi (M6)
items: Nzi icyo alikoli y'amatsinda menshi ari cyo.
Nzi izina rya shimi rya glikoli (amatsinda 2 ya OH) na glisero (amatsinda 3 ya OH).
Nzi bimwe mu biranga glikoli na glisero n'icyo bikoreshwa.

sections.title: 7. Asidi organike (M7)
items: Nzi icyo itsinda rya karubokisile (−COOH) ari cyo. Ni itsinda riba buri gihe ku asidi organike.
Nshobora kuvuga izina no gushushanya imiterere y'isano ya asidi formike (asidi metanoyike) na asidi ya vinaigre (asidi etanoyike).
Nzi ko alikoli ishobora guhinduka asidi binyuze muri oxidasiyo, urugero etanoli ihinduka asidi ya vinaigre iyo iri mu mwuka.
Nzi ko asidi formike, mu bindi, ikoreshwa mu kubika ubwatsi bubitswe (ensilage).

sections.title: 8. Esiteri (M8)
items: Nzi uko esiteri ikorwa (guhindura esiteri: alikoli + asidi → esiteri + amazi).
Nshobora kuvuga izina rya esiteri nshingiye ku gice cyayo cya alikoli n'icya asidi (urugero etanoli + asidi butanoyike → etilibutanowate).
Nzi ko ibinure ari esiteri za glisero n'asidi z'ibinure.

sections.title: ★ Kwimbika
sections.note: Ku ushaka kujya kure kurushaho – bihuza n'amakadiri yo kwimbika yo mu gitabo cyo kwiga.
items: Nzi icyo garafene na nanotubu ari cyo, kandi ko garafene yahawe igihembo cya Nobel muri fiziki mu 2010.
Nzi icyo hidrokaboni aromatike ari cyo kandi nshobora gutanga benzene nk'urugero.
Nzi icyo asidi amine ari cyo (asidi organike ifite itsinda ry'amine) kandi ko asidi amine zubaka proteyine.
